Seamless tileable close-up texture of a white concrete bridge pylon, Yichang Yiling Yangtze River Bridge, photographed at night under soft floodlight. Pale cool-white concrete with a very slight blue-grey cast, fine aggregate grain, horizontal formwork panel joints with thin dark shadow lines every few metres, faint vertical rain streaks, sparse dark water stains and small rust-free tie-rod marks. No graffiti, no paint stripe, no blue band, no cables, no sky, no landscape, no people, no text. Flat even diffuse light, straight-on orthographic view, photorealistic, high detail, tileable in both directions, neutral cool white balance.
